injuries.name: Patrick Kane
injuries.note: Drew Commesso was recalled from AHL Rockford in a corresponding move. Kane has already missed three games after getting injured Monday versus the Avalanche. His placement on IR is retroactive to Nov. 2, so he could he return to the lineup Thursday against the Sabres if he is ready by then. However, it's unclear at this time how the veteran is doing in his recovery progress.

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: In a corresponding move, Chicago recalled forward Dillon Boucher from AHL Rochester. Byram hasn't played since Oct. 13, and it remains unclear when he will be available to return. He has one assist, five shots on net, nine blocked shots and two hits in six appearances this season.

injuries.name: William Carrier
injuries.note: Knee: Carrier was removed from Saturday's (Nov. 7) game versus the Blackhawks for precautionary reasons due to a right knee injury, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Staal
injuries.note: Calf: The Carolina Hurricanes placed F Jordan Staal on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 15).

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Chicago Blackhawks placed D Bowen Byram on injured reserve on Tuesday (Nov. 3).

injuries.name: Ryan Ellis
injuries.note: Back: The Chicago Blackhawks placed D Ryan Ellis on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Patrick Kane
injuries.note: Upper-body: Kane has an upper-body injury and will miss at least the next couple of games, per Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times.
